description_en: Invokes this operation to query the list of over-the-air update upgrade packages
description_zh: 调用该接口查询OTA升级包列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot list-ota-firmware --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a19mzPZ0000 --page-size 10 --current-page 1 --dest-version 4.0.0 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOTAFirmware

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the over-the-air update upgrade package belongs.

If you specify this parameter, the over-the-air update upgrade packages of the specified product are queried. If you do not specify this parameter, all over-the-air update upgrade packages of the current Alibaba Cloud account are returned
parameters.help_zh:
OTA升级包所属产品的ProductKey。

传入该参数，则查询指定产品下的OTA升级包列表；不传入此参数，则返回当前阿里云账号下的所有OTA升级包列表
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The number of firmware entries to display on each page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的固件数量。最大限制为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to display from the returned results. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。页数从1开始排序
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The version number of the over-the-air update upgrade package. If you specify this parameter, the over-the-air update upgrade package with the specified version number is queried
parameters.help_zh: OTA升级包版本号。传入该参数，则查询版本号为指定版本号的OTA升级包
parameters.name: dest_version

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

SimpleFirmwareInfo.description_en: The list of over-the-air update upgrade packages returned if the invocation is successful. For details, see SimpleFirmwareInfo below
SimpleFirmwareInfo.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的OTA升级包列表。详情参见以下SimpleFirmwareInfo

DestVersion.description_en: The version number of the current over-the-air update upgrade package

FirmwareDesc.description_en: The description of the over-the-air update upgrade package

FirmwareId.description_en: The ID of the over-the-air update upgrade package, which is the unique identity of the over-the-air update upgrade package
FirmwareId.description_zh: OTA升级包ID，OTA升级包的唯一标识符

FirmwareName.description_en: The name of the over-the-air update upgrade package

FirmwareSign.description_en: The signature value of the over-the-air update upgrade package content

FirmwareSize.description_en: The size of the over-the-air update upgrade package, in bytes

ModuleName.description_en: The module name of the over-the-air update upgrade package

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the over-the-air update upgrade package belongs

ProductName.description_en: The name of the product to which the over-the-air update upgrade package belongs
ProductName.description_zh: OTA升级包所属产品的名称

SignMethod.description_en: The signature method of the over-the-air update upgrade package

SrcVersion.description_en:
The source version number of the over-the-air update upgrade package.

This parameter is empty for full over-the-air update upgrade packages
SrcVersion.description_zh:
待升OTA升级包版本号。

整包OTA升级包返回的该参数为空

Status.description_en:
The status of the over-the-air update upgrade package.

0: Not authenticated.
1: Authenticated.
2: Authenticating.
3: Authentication failed
Status.description_zh:
OTA升级包状态。

0：未验证。
1：已验证。
2：验证中。
3：验证失败

Type.description_en:
The type of the over-the-air update upgrade package.

0: Full update firmware.
1: Delta update firmware
Type.description_zh:
OTA升级包类型。

0：整包固件。
1：差分固件

UtcCreate.description_en: The time when the over-the-air update upgrade package was created, in UTC format
UtcCreate.description_zh: OTA升级包创建时的时间，UTC格式

UtcModified.description_en: The time when the over-the-air update upgrade package was last modified, in UTC format
UtcModified.description_zh: OTA升级包最后一次修改时的时间，UTC格式

PageSize.description_en: The number of firmware entries displayed on each page

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败

Total.description_en: The total number of over-the-air update upgrade packages
